pages.ja:
疾走。停止。一撃。
キャスターの神言を全て弾き返し、誰にも対抗する隙を与えず、セイバーは勝負を決した。
踏み込む速度、大地に落とした足捌き、横一文字に振り抜いた剣に是非はない。
彼女の視えない剣は敵マスターを一閃した。
最高の機を窺っての奇襲である。
斬撃は大木を断つほどの会心さで、仕損じる事なく葛木宗一郎を二つに分ける。

pages.en:
A charge. A halt. A single stroke.

Saber repels every divine word Caster hurls at her and settles the battle before anyone has the slightest chance to resist.

There is no fault in the speed of her advance, the foot she plants against the earth, or the sword she sweeps in one level arc.

Her invisible blade flashes through the enemy Master.

The ambush has come at the perfect instant.

The stroke is true enough to fell a great tree. Without the least chance of failure, it cuts Souichirou Kuzuki in two.

pages.ja:
いや
分ける、筈だった。
pages.jaRuby:
いや
分ける、筈だった。
pages.en:
No—

it should have cut him in two.

pages.ja:
「な
」
当惑で息が漏れる。
一体どうなっているのか、と。
剣を振るった姿勢のまま、彼女は呆然と目の前の敵を見た。
pages.jaRuby:
「な
」
当惑で息が漏れる。
一体どうなっているのか、と。
剣を振るった姿勢のまま、[ruby text=セイバー char=2]彼女は呆然と目の前の敵を見た。
pages.en:
“What—”

A breath escapes her in confusion.

What has happened?

Still frozen in the posture of her completed stroke, Saber herself stares blankly at the enemy before her.

pages.ja:
「
ばか、な」
彼女でさえ事態が掴めていない。
横一線になぎ払った必殺の一撃。
それが止まっている。
敵の胴体を薙ぎ払う直前に、何かに刀身を挟まれて停止している。
pages.jaRuby:
「

それが止まっている。
敵の胴体を薙ぎ払う直前に、何かに刀身を挟まれて停止している。
pages.en:
“—Impossible.”

Even she cannot grasp what has happened.

Her killing stroke, swept in a horizontal line—

has stopped.

Something has caught the blade an instant before it can tear through the enemy's body.

pages.ja:
「
足と、腕？」
そんな奇蹟が起こりえるのか。
彼女の剣は、敵である葛木宗一郎によって止められていた。
膝と肘。
高速で斬り払われるソレを、男は片方の膝と肘で、挟み込むように止めていたのだ。
pages.jaRuby:
「
足と、腕？」
そんな奇蹟が起こりえるのか。
彼女の剣は、敵である葛木宗一郎によって止められていた。
膝と肘。
高速で斬り払われるソレを、男は片方の膝と肘で、[ruby text=・・・・・・・・・・・・・・ o2o=1]挟み込むように止めていたのだ。
pages.en:
“—His leg… and arm?”

Can such an absurd miracle exist?

Her sword has been stopped by the enemy, Souichirou Kuzuki.

Knee and elbow.

The man has clamped the blade between one knee and one elbow, catching it in the midst of its high-speed sweep.

pages.ja:
「
」
無論、彼女は知らない。
素手で相手の武器
刃を受け止める武術がある事も、それを実現する達人の事も。
それでも、これが通常の戦いなら放心する事などなかっただろう。

pages.en:
“—”

Of course, she does not know.

She has never heard of a martial art that catches an opponent's weapon—a naked blade—with the bare body, nor of masters capable of such a feat.

Even so, had this been an ordinary battle, she would never have stood there dumbfounded.

pages.ja:
だが事はサーヴァント戦。
敵はあくまでただの人間だ。
それが必殺の一撃、視えない刀身を捉え、かつ素手で押し止めたなど、もはや正気の沙汰ではない……！
pages.jaRuby:
だが事はサーヴァント戦。
敵はあくまでただの人間だ。
それが必殺の一撃、視えない刀身を捉え、かつ素手で押し止めたなど、もはや正気の沙汰ではない……！
pages.en:
But this is a battle between Servants.

Her opponent is, in the end, only human.

For a mere man to catch an invisible blade in the midst of its killing stroke, then hold it fast with his unprotected limbs—there is no sanity in it…!

pages.ja:
「
侮ったな、セイバー」
それは、地の底から響いてくるような声だった。
「…………っっっ！！！！」
セイバーの体が流れる。
止められた剣を全力で引き戻そうとする。
pages.jaRuby:
「
侮ったな、セイバー」

「…………っっっ！！！！」
セイバーの体が流れる。
止められた剣を全力で引き戻そうとする。
pages.en:
“—You underestimated me, Saber.”

His voice seems to rise from the depths of the earth.

“…………—!!!!”

Saber's body twists.

She pulls with all her strength, trying to wrench the trapped sword free.

pages.ja:
その瞬間。
「がっ
！？」
彼女の後頭部に、正体不明の衝撃が炸裂した。
pages.jaRuby:

！？」
彼女の後頭部に、正体不明の衝撃が炸裂した。
pages.en:
At that instant—

“Gah—!?”

an incomprehensible impact explodes against the back of her head.

pages.ja:
「は、っ
！？」
訳が判らない。
素手で剣を止める、などという相手は初めてだ。
いや、となると今のは素手による攻撃か。
つまりは殴られた。この間合い、互いに息のかかる距離で、後頭部を殴られた……？

pages.en:
“Hah—what—!?”

She cannot understand it.

Never before has she fought anyone who stopped a sword barehanded.

Then was that last blow an attack with his bare hands?

He struck her. From this distance, close enough for each to feel the other's breath, he somehow struck the back of her head…?

pages.ja:
「っ
！」
正体が掴めないまま回避する。
「は
！」
こめかみを掠っていく“何か”。
それが何らかの魔術によって“強化”された拳であると看破し、セイバーは跳んだ。

pages.en:
“—!”

She evades without yet understanding what she is evading.

“Hah—!”

Something grazes her temple.

Saber recognizes a fist Reinforced through some form of magecraft and leaps away.

pages.ja:
長柄の武器を持つ以上、素手の相手に対して接近戦では不利だ。
セイバーは自身の間合い、剣を生かす一足一刀の間合いまで後退する。

pages.en:
A long weapon puts her at a disadvantage this close, inside the reach of an unarmed fighter.

Saber retreats a single sword-step, into the range where her own blade can finally work.

pages.ja:
無論、体は敵を見据えたまま。
敵にとって有利な間合いを離そうというのだ。
当然逃がすまいと追ってくる敵を迎え撃つのが定石である。
が、敵は追ってはこなかった。
キャスターのマスター、狙われれば倒されるしかないその男は、その場に踏み留まったまま、
彼女の鳩尾を貫いていた。

pages.en:
She never takes her eyes from the enemy.

Her purpose is to leave the range that favors him.

Ordinarily, she would meet his inevitable pursuit with a counterstroke.

But the enemy does not pursue.

Caster's Master—the man who ought to be helpless once targeted—remains planted where he stood,

and drives a blow through her solar plexus.

pages.ja:
「っ
！？」
吐息が漏れる。
貫いたのは衝撃だけだ。
攻撃は鎧に阻まれ、その衝撃だけを伝えてくる。
pages.jaRuby:

“—!?”

Her breath escapes.

Only the impact passes through her.

Her armor stops the blow itself, transmitting nothing but its force.

！」

“Hah—ah—!”

More impacts follow.

They seek only her vital points with unerring precision, and they are unmistakably the fists of a human being.

神鉄で作られたかのような強度と重さをもって、男の拳はセイバーをつるべ撃つ。

pages.en:
“—”

Did she even have time to draw breath?

By the time she understands that those rocklike fingers are the source of the impacts, the battle has already been decided.

A rain of fists descends.

With the strength and weight of god-forged iron, the man's fists hammer Saber without pause.

放たれる速度が閃光ならば、そこから更に変化する二の腕は鬼神の業か。

How can such a thing be described?

His arms flex like whips, yet their course changes only through rigid right angles.

If the first motion is as swift as light, then the second transformation through his upper arm is the work of some demon god.

“Hah—gh—!?”

Every blow is difficult even to perceive, and every one seeks nothing but a vital point.

She is given no chance to retaliate.

Even the arm that wields her sword is targeted. Each blow sends pain through her armor and into her very core.

pages.ja:

大きく周りこむ腕は肘を支点に軌道を変え、あらぬ方向からセイバーを打ちのめす。

pages.en:
Every attack moves from the outside inward.

His arm sweeps wide, changes course around the pivot of the elbow, and batters Saber from impossible directions.

pages.ja:
「は

！」
鈍重で鋭利。
即死性はなく、だが死に至る毒を帯びた突起物。
それがこの攻撃の全てだった。
拳は躱せないものの、威力はそう大きくない。
だが
受ける度に、痛みで意識が停止する。
その僅かな隙をつき、根こそぎ意識を刈り取ろうと後頭部に食いつく一撃は、死の鎌を連想させた。

pages.en:
“Hah—kh—!”

Blunt, yet piercing.

The attacks are like barbs tipped with a slow but fatal poison.

That is the whole of his method.

The fists cannot be evaded, but no single blow carries overwhelming force.

Yet each time one lands, the pain brings her mind to a halt.

The next blow exploits that fractional opening and snaps at the back of her head, seeking to reap consciousness by the roots. It calls to mind the scythe of death.

pages.ja:
「っ…………！」
それを直感だけで回避する。
腕や胸を狙う一撃はいい。
だが頭
後頭部を打たれては倒される。
それ故、セイバーはその一撃にだけ神経を集中する。
剣を素手で止める怪人。
初体験とも言える奇怪な攻撃方法を前にして、彼女が頼りにするものは己が直感だけだった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“…………!”

She escapes it on instinct alone.

Blows to her arms and chest can be endured.

But one to her head—the back of her skull—will bring her down.

And so Saber devotes every faculty to that one attack.

A monstrous man who stopped her sword with his bare flesh.

Confronted with a mode of attack she has never experienced, she has nothing to trust but her own instinct.

pages.ja:
「
よく躱す。未だ混乱しているというのにな」
敵の腕が止まる。
その構えは、拳と同じく岩のように不動。
pages.jaRuby:

敵の腕が止まる。
その構えは、拳と同じく岩のように不動。
pages.en:
“—You evade well, considering that you remain confused.”

The enemy's arms come to rest.

Like the fists themselves, his stance is immovable as stone.

pages.ja:
「
なるほど。眼がいいのではなく、勘がいいという事か」
「
！」
男の体が動く。
繰り出される一撃は何が違ったのか。
確実に致命傷を避けていたセイバーは、その一撃を躱せなかった。
pages.jaRuby:

！」

確実に致命傷を避けていたセイバーは、その一撃を躱せなかった。
pages.en:
“—I see. It is not your eyes that are keen, but your intuition.”

“—!”

The man's body moves.

What was different about the blow he unleashed?

Saber had avoided every mortal wound with certainty, yet this one she cannot evade.

pages.ja:
「あ
」
意識が落ちる。
後頭部に落ちた衝撃が脳を侵す。
「く
！」
それでも両腕を上げた。
男の攻撃では彼女の鎧を突破できない。
ならば
男が狙うのは、剥き出しである彼女の顔だ。

pages.en:
“Ah—”

Her consciousness falls away.

The blow to the back of her head sends shock flooding through her brain.

“Kh—!”

Even so, she raises both arms.

The man's attacks cannot break through her armor.

Then he will aim for the one place left bare—her face.

pages.ja:
セイバーは両腕をあげ、自らの顔を守る。
「がっ
！」
抜けてくる衝撃。
それは、密林を這う蛇そのものだった。
顔を覆った腕の合間を、敵の拳は容易くすり抜けた。
pages.jaRuby:

！」

顔を覆った腕の合間を、敵の拳は[ruby text=たやす char=2]容易くすり抜けた。
pages.en:
Saber raises both arms to shield it.

“Gah—!”

The impact slips through.

It is a serpent crawling through a dense jungle.

The enemy's fist glides effortlessly through the narrow gaps between the arms covering her face.

pages.ja:
「つ
く…………！」
意識が遠のく。

pages.jaRuby:
「つ
く…………！」
意識が遠のく。
“蛇”の胴体、左腕の肘が、セイバーの鎖骨へと叩き込まれる。
pages.en:
“Kh… guh…………!”

Consciousness recedes.

The serpent's body—his left elbow—drives toward Saber's collarbone.

pages.ja:
それをわずかに後退して躱し、セイバーは剣を握りしめた。
その先にある変化。
肘先から変化し、左側面から後頭部を狙ってくる一撃に備えた。
もはや、この相手を侮る事などできない。
相手が意識を刈り獲るというのなら獲らせる。
だが、その直後に見返りとして両腕を斬り落とそう、と彼女は両目を見開き、
その変化に、愕然とした。

pages.en:
She slips back just far enough to evade it and tightens both hands upon her sword.

She prepares for what comes next: the blow changing at the elbow to sweep from her left into the back of her head.

—She can no longer afford to underestimate this opponent.

If he means to reap her consciousness, she will let him.

But immediately afterward, she will claim both his arms in payment.

Her eyes fly open—and widen in horror at the change before her.

肘を支点に、真上から垂直に落ちてくる。
今まで円を描いていた軌道が、ここにきて線……！

Pivoting at the elbow, the arm drops vertically from overhead.

The path that had always described an arc has suddenly become a line…!

pages.en:
“—Hah…………!!!!”

She jerks her head aside, evading the blow descending upon her crown.

“Guh…!”

The impact falls upon her shoulder.

The instant she glares at her enemy, certain that her left shoulder has been utterly destroyed, a chill runs the length of her spine.

His right arm—the one he has not used even once until now.

The right fist that has remained poised at the height of her throat launches like a cannonball.

pages.en:
“—”

Until now, his attacks have been lines. At last, they become a point.

A thrusting fist fired straight at Saber, standing directly before him.

This man possesses the precision to pass through an opening no larger than a needle's eye. With it, the blow can pierce her.

With all the power he has stored behind it, piercing Saber's throat, breaking her spine, and tearing her head from her body would be almost contemptuously easy—!

“—!!!!!!!”

But even that fails.

A surprise attack cannot overcome her instinct, which borders upon foreknowledge.

The serpent's fist grazes the side of her neck.

She watches it pass and steps forward to turn her blade upon him.

At that instant—

Crack.

An impossible sound comes from beside her throat.

The serpent's fangs sink in.

The hand that grazed Saber's neck drives its fingers into her flesh at the very instant the thrust is evaded.

“—That piercing needle… it was an anchor…!”

Astonishment races through her and becomes terror.

Yes. A hand is not, by nature, made to strike. It is made to seize.

Perhaps aided by Caster's magical energy, the enemy's fingers begin crushing Saber's throat with appalling ease…!

Before she can swing the sword, her own body is swung like a blade.

The sensation of leaving the ground.

An overhand pitch.

Still gripping Saber by the throat, the man hurls her away with one arm.

A human body cast like a fastball.

There is no possibility of breaking her fall.

Thrown with the flesh of her throat tearing away, she smashes into a concrete wall at two hundred kilometers per hour.

“Ah… —”

Her body goes utterly still.
